section: Ocean-atmosphere interaction - El Nino, La Nina, ENSO, Indian Ocean Dipole, Walker circulation

accepted.s: The Nino 3.4 region is geographically defined by which of the following coordinates?
accepted.x: The Nino 3.4 region lies in the central equatorial Pacific between 5°N and 5°S and 120°W and 170°W.
accepted.tq: Use exact latitude-longitude boundaries to distinguish neighbouring Pacific monitoring regions.

accepted.s:
With reference to the declaration of El Nino and La Nina conditions, consider the following statements:
1. El Nino is declared when the central equatorial Pacific is at least 0.5°C warmer than average.
2. The temperature anomaly must persist for five consecutive overlapping three-month periods for El Nino declaration.
3. La Nina is associated with a half-degree cooling of the central equatorial Pacific.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. El Nino requires warming of at least 0.5°C for five consecutive overlapping three-month periods, while La Nina represents a half-degree cooling.
accepted.tq: Check the threshold, duration and sign of the temperature anomaly separately.

accepted.s: The Dipole Mode Index (DMI) is used for monitoring which of the following ocean-atmosphere phenomena?
accepted.x: The Indian Ocean Dipole is monitored through the Dipole Mode Index, or DMI.
accepted.tq: Match the specialised index with the phenomenon it monitors.

accepted.s: A DMI value of –0.34°C recorded in late May 2026 was classified as which of the following?
accepted.x: The DMI value of –0.34°C in late May 2026 was assessed as neutral for the Indian Ocean Dipole.
accepted.tq: Read the sign, magnitude and classification together rather than treating every negative value as an event.

accepted.s: Which satellite mission is associated with tracking Kelvin waves as an early signal of El Nino?
accepted.x: NASA's Sentinel-6 Michael Freilich tracks Kelvin waves, which can provide an early signal of El Nino development.
accepted.tq: Use the instrument–function association to avoid confusing monitoring platforms.

accepted.s: In its April 2026 forecast, the India Meteorological Department projected the southwest monsoon at what level of the Long Period Average?
accepted.x: The IMD forecast projected a below-normal monsoon at 92% of the Long Period Average, whose reference value was stated as 87 cm.
accepted.tq: Distinguish closely spaced percentage figures in a forecast question.

accepted.s: The IMD's April 2026 monsoon forecast was significant because it represented which of the following?
o: Its first forecast based exclusively on the Indian Ocean Dipole
Its first below-normal April warning in 11 years
Its first cyclone warning issued in April
Its first above-normal April forecast in 11 years
accepted.x: The April 2026 forecast was the IMD's first below-normal April warning in 11 years.
accepted.tq: Focus on the precise comparison and time span rather than the general forecast outcome.

accepted.s: Which ocean-atmosphere condition was cited as the reason for the IMD's April 2026 below-normal monsoon forecast?
o: A reduction in Bay of Bengal sea-surface temperature
accepted.x: The below-normal monsoon forecast was attributed to a developing El Nino.
accepted.tq: Apply the stated cause-effect relationship between ENSO conditions and monsoon prospects.

accepted.s: In May 2026, the IMD warned of the possibility of which condition?
o: A complete failure of the Indian monsoon
accepted.x: The IMD warned in May 2026 of a possible Super El Nino.
accepted.tq: Identify the exact official warning without extending it into an unsupported prediction.

accepted.s: An INCOIS study associated ENSO most directly with which of the following?
o: The number of post-monsoon Bay of Bengal cyclones
The number of winter storms in the Arabian Sea only
The salinity of all Indian rivers
accepted.x: The INCOIS study found that ENSO governs the number of post-monsoon, or October–December, cyclones in the Bay of Bengal.
accepted.tq: Link the climate driver to the specific regional hazard and season identified.

accepted.s: Which inference regarding El Nino and Bay of Bengal cyclones is supported by the INCOIS study?
o: El Nino may reduce post-monsoon Bay of Bengal cyclones.
El Nino always increases post-monsoon Bay of Bengal cyclones.
El Nino shifts all Bay of Bengal cyclones to the Arabian Sea.
El Nino has no relationship with Bay of Bengal cyclones.
accepted.x: The study indicated that El Nino may reduce the number of post-monsoon Bay of Bengal cyclones.
accepted.tq: Use the cautious wording ‘may’ and distinguish a possible tendency from an absolute rule.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the relevance of ENSO-related cyclone and monsoon changes to Andhra Pradesh?
o: They are unrelated to agricultural conditions in Andhra Pradesh.
They influence only irrigation-fed agriculture in Rayalaseema.
They can affect coastal Andhra Pradesh and rain-fed farming in Rayalaseema.
They affect only the inland districts and not coastal Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.x: Fewer or more Bay of Bengal cyclones and weak monsoon years directly affect coastal Andhra Pradesh and rain-fed Rayalaseema farming.
accepted.tq: Translate a broad climate relationship into its regional agricultural and hazard consequences.

accepted.s: The NIOT OMNI buoys located off Nellore are relevant primarily to which activity?
o: Monitoring volcanic activity in the Pacific
accepted.x: NIOT OMNI buoys off Nellore support monitoring of the Indian Ocean Dipole.
accepted.tq: Match the regional observing platform with its stated monitoring purpose.

accepted.s:
Arrange the following developments in chronological order:
A. Identification of the Indian Ocean Dipole
B. Last El Nino mentioned in the record
C. First description of the Southern Oscillation by Walker

Choose the correct sequence.
accepted.x: Walker first described the Southern Oscillation in the 1920s, the Indian Ocean Dipole was identified in 1999, and the last El Nino mentioned was in 2023–24.
accepted.tq: Anchor the sequence using the 1920s, 1999 and 2023–24 time markers.

accepted.s: Who first described the Southern Oscillation?
accepted.x: Walker first described the Southern Oscillation in the 1920s.
accepted.tq: Identify the scientist associated with the original description rather than a later monitoring agency.

accepted.s: The Indian Ocean Dipole was identified in which year?
accepted.x: The Indian Ocean Dipole was identified in 1999.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the historical identification year from later ENSO events.

accepted.s: The last El Nino referred to in the stated chronology occurred during which period?
accepted.x: The last El Nino identified in the chronology occurred in 2023–24.
accepted.tq: Use the event-period pair directly and avoid substituting another well-known El Nino episode.
